name: Engine fixture (D1)
about: THE ENGINE'S HAND-WRITTEN FIXTURE (docs/PLAN_dungeons.md D1): not built with the kit generators -- shell.json beside it is written by hand to exercise every op and shape the engine evaluates, and it is placed on the HARNESS map for the dungeon-format / dungeon-gen gates. Editing this file makes shell.bin STALE (its sourceHash), which dungeon-format reports; re-stamp shell.json's sourceHash and run `sandvox --dungeon-bake _fixture`.

pieces.about: a stair cut down from the surface along +x, 60 cells over 120
a 400-cell barrel-vaulted corridor with two timber sets, a cobble skin and an ore scatter
a rounded chamber with a natural-rock pillar (keep), a flagstone floor, rubble piles, stalactites and an alcove prop
a vault along +z: moss, puddles, bones
